trans-unit.target: Un'arma benedetta da Kurnous per rendere il suo portatore uno dei più grandi cacciatori che il mondo conosca. Coloro che sono segnati dalle sue frecce provano una paura primordiale, come se fossero cacciati dalla natura stessa piuttosto che da un semplice arciere.

trans-unit.source: This helmet reveals a face mask that is a mixture of terror, bloodlust and pure desire for violence. The visage transforms its wearer, awakening a primal rage that enemies can sense from afar.
trans-unit.target: Questo elmo rivela una maschera facciale che è un miscuglio di terrore, sete di sangue e puro desiderio di violenza. Il volto trasforma chi lo indossa, risvegliando una rabbia primordiale che i nemici possono percepire da lontano.

trans-unit.source: A sword thirsting for blood as much as its master. With each strike, it hungers for more, growing stronger with each life it claims. The blade's edge never dulls when wetted with fresh blood.
trans-unit.target: Una spada assetata di sangue tanto quanto il suo padrone. Con ogni colpo, brama di più, diventando più forte con ogni vita che reclama. Il filo della lama non si smussa mai quando è bagnato di sangue fresco.

trans-unit.source: A sword as perfect as its wielder strives to be. Forged in the eternal flame of Asuryan himself, this high elven style sword brings harmony to combat, allowing its master to fight with unmatched precision and endurance.
trans-unit.target: Una spada perfetta quanto il suo portatore aspira ad essere. Forgiata nella fiamma eterna di Asuryan stesso, questa spada in stile alto elfico porta armonia al combattimento, permettendo al suo maestro di combattere con precisione e resistenza senza pari.

trans-unit.source: An armour by Kurnous design, light and barely noticeable. This dark green cloak carries the essence of the deep forest, concealing its wearer from enemy eyes while heightening awareness of one's surroundings.
trans-unit.target: Un'armatura di design di Kurnous, leggera e appena percettibile. Questo mantello verde scuro porta l'essenza della foresta profonda, nascondendo chi lo indossa agli occhi nemici mentre aumenta la consapevolezza dell'ambiente circostante.

trans-unit.source: This armor protects its wearer while he serves elven kind, prolonging his life to levels outside any expectation. The enchantments woven into each plate reject the corruption of undeath, allowing the wearer to walk both worlds.
trans-unit.target: Questa armatura protegge chi la indossa mentre serve la stirpe elfica, prolungando la sua vita a livelli oltre ogni aspettativa. Gli incantesimi intessuti in ogni piastra respingono la corruzione della non-morte, permettendo a chi la indossa di camminare tra entrambi i mondi.

trans-unit.source: A talisman blessed by Khaine, the Blood-Handed God. Few have gained enough favor to wield a tool like this in his name. The dried blood pulsates with ancient power, whispering promises of violence to its bearer.
trans-unit.target: 피의 신 카인의 축복을 받은 부적. 그의 이름으로 이런 도구를 휘두를 만큼 충분한 은총을 얻은 자는 거의 없습니다. 마른 피는 고대의 힘으로 맥동하며, 소유자에게 폭력의 약속을 속삭입니다.

trans-unit.source: A talisman blessed by Asuryan to keep the knowledge of previous generations alive. When quiet, you can hear the whispers of ancient elven sages offering wisdom from beyond the veil.
trans-unit.target: 이전 세대의 지식을 살아있게 하기 위해 아수리안이 축복한 부적. 조용할 때, 베일 너머에서 지혜를 제공하는 고대 엘프 현자들의 속삭임을 들을 수 있습니다.

trans-unit.source: A talisman of sorts blessed by Kurnous, giving the owner some of the best berry wine in the whole world. One sip connects the drinker to the wild, sharpening senses and quickening reflexes as if the forest itself guides each movement.
trans-unit.target: 쿠르노스의 축복을 받은 일종의 부적으로, 소유자에게 세상에서 가장 좋은 베리 와인을 줍니다. 한 모금 마시면 마시는 자와 야생이 연결되어 감각이 예리해지고 반사 신경이 빨라져 마치 숲 자체가 모든 움직임을 인도하는 것 같습니다.

trans-unit.source: A weapon blessed by Kurnous to make its wielder into one of the foremost hunters the world knows. Those marked by its arrows feel a primal fear, as if hunted by nature itself rather than merely an archer.
trans-unit.target: 쿠르노스의 축복을 받아 사용자를 세계가 아는 최고의 사냥꾼 중 하나로 만드는 무기. 그 화살에 맞은 자들은 단순한 궁수가 아닌 자연 자체에 사냥당하는 듯한 원초적 공포를 느낍니다.

trans-unit.source: This helmet reveals a face mask that is a mixture of terror, bloodlust and pure desire for violence. The visage transforms its wearer, awakening a primal rage that enemies can sense from afar.
trans-unit.target: 이 투구는 공포, 피에 대한 갈망, 순수한 폭력 욕구가 혼합된 가면을 드러냅니다. 이 모습은 착용자를 변화시켜 적들이 멀리서도 감지할 수 있는 원초적 분노를 일깨웁니다.

trans-unit.source: A sword thirsting for blood as much as its master. With each strike, it hungers for more, growing stronger with each life it claims. The blade's edge never dulls when wetted with fresh blood.

trans-unit.source: A sword as perfect as its wielder strives to be. Forged in the eternal flame of Asuryan himself, this high elven style sword brings harmony to combat, allowing its master to fight with unmatched precision and endurance.

trans-unit.source: An armour by Kurnous design, light and barely noticeable. This dark green cloak carries the essence of the deep forest, concealing its wearer from enemy eyes while heightening awareness of one's surroundings.
trans-unit.target: 쿠르노스 디자인의 갑옷으로, 가볍고 거의 눈에 띄지 않습니다. 이 짙은 녹색 망토는 깊은 숲의 본질을 담아 적의 눈으로부터 착용자를 숨기면서 주변에 대한 인식을 높입니다.

trans-unit.source: This armor protects its wearer while he serves elven kind, prolonging his life to levels outside any expectation. The enchantments woven into each plate reject the corruption of undeath, allowing the wearer to walk both worlds.

trans-unit.source: A talisman of sorts blessed by Kurnous, giving the owner some of the best berry wine in the whole world. One sip connects the drinker to the wild, sharpening senses and quickening reflexes as if the forest itself guides each movement.

trans-unit.source: A weapon blessed by Kurnous to make its wielder into one of the foremost hunters the world knows. Those marked by its arrows feel a primal fear, as if hunted by nature itself rather than merely an archer.

trans-unit.source: This helmet reveals a face mask that is a mixture of terror, bloodlust and pure desire for violence. The visage transforms its wearer, awakening a primal rage that enemies can sense from afar.
trans-unit.target: Ten hełm odsłania maskę będącą mieszanką terroru, krwiożerczości i czystego pragnienia przemocy. Oblicze przemienia swego nosiciela, budząc pierwotną furię, którą wrogowie wyczuwają z daleka.

trans-unit.source: A sword thirsting for blood as much as its master. With each strike, it hungers for more, growing stronger with each life it claims. The blade's edge never dulls when wetted with fresh blood.
trans-unit.target: Miecz spragniony krwi równie mocno jak jego pan. Z każdym ciosem pragnie więcej, rosnąc w siłę z każdym życiem, które pochłania. Ostrze nigdy nie tępieje, gdy zwilży je świeża krew.

trans-unit.source: A sword as perfect as its wielder strives to be. Forged in the eternal flame of Asuryan himself, this high elven style sword brings harmony to combat, allowing its master to fight with unmatched precision and endurance.
trans-unit.target: Miecz tak doskonały, jak jego władca dąży być. Wykuty w wiecznym płomieniu samego Asuryana, ten wysokoelficki miecz wprowadza harmonię do walki, pozwalając swemu panu walczyć z niezrównaną precyzją i wytrzymałością.

trans-unit.source: An armour by Kurnous design, light and barely noticeable. This dark green cloak carries the essence of the deep forest, concealing its wearer from enemy eyes while heightening awareness of one's surroundings.
trans-unit.target: Zbroja projektu Kurnousa, lekka i ledwo zauważalna. Ten ciemnozielony płaszcz nosi esencję głębokiego lasu, ukrywając swego nosiciela przed oczami wrogów, jednocześnie wyostrzając świadomość otoczenia.

trans-unit.source: This armor protects its wearer while he serves elven kind, prolonging his life to levels outside any expectation. The enchantments woven into each plate reject the corruption of undeath, allowing the wearer to walk both worlds.
trans-unit.target: Ta zbroja chroni swego nosiciela, gdy służy elfickiemu ludowi, przedłużając jego życie ponad wszelkie oczekiwania. Zaklęcia wplecione w każdą płytę odpychają skazę nieumarłości, pozwalając nosicielowi kroczyć między oboma światami.

trans-unit.source: A talisman blessed by Khaine, the Blood-Handed God. Few have gained enough favor to wield a tool like this in his name. The dried blood pulsates with ancient power, whispering promises of violence to its bearer.
trans-unit.target: Талисман, благословлённый Кхейном, Кровавым Богом. Лишь немногие заслужили достаточно его милости, чтобы владеть подобным орудием от его имени. Засохшая кровь пульсирует древней силой, нашёптывая своему носителю обещания насилия.

trans-unit.source: A talisman blessed by Asuryan to keep the knowledge of previous generations alive. When quiet, you can hear the whispers of ancient elven sages offering wisdom from beyond the veil.
trans-unit.target: Талисман, благословлённый Асурианом для сохранения знаний прошлых поколений. В тишине можно услышать шёпот древних эльфийских мудрецов, предлагающих мудрость из-за грани.

trans-unit.source: A talisman of sorts blessed by Kurnous, giving the owner some of the best berry wine in the whole world. One sip connects the drinker to the wild, sharpening senses and quickening reflexes as if the forest itself guides each movement.
trans-unit.target: Своего рода талисман, благословлённый Курноусом, дарующий владельцу лучшее ягодное вино во всём мире. Один глоток соединяет пьющего с дикой природой, обостряя чувства и ускоряя рефлексы, словно сам лес направляет каждое движение.

trans-unit.source: A weapon blessed by Kurnous to make its wielder into one of the foremost hunters the world knows. Those marked by its arrows feel a primal fear, as if hunted by nature itself rather than merely an archer.
trans-unit.target: Оружие, благословлённое Курноусом, чтобы превратить своего владельца в одного из величайших охотников мира. Те, кого поразили его стрелы, чувствуют первобытный страх, словно за ними охотится сама природа, а не просто лучник.

trans-unit.source: This helmet reveals a face mask that is a mixture of terror, bloodlust and pure desire for violence. The visage transforms its wearer, awakening a primal rage that enemies can sense from afar.

trans-unit.source: A sword thirsting for blood as much as its master. With each strike, it hungers for more, growing stronger with each life it claims. The blade's edge never dulls when wetted with fresh blood.
trans-unit.target: Меч, жаждущий крови не меньше своего хозяина. С каждым ударом он алкает большего, становясь сильнее с каждой отнятой жизнью. Лезвие никогда не тупится, омытое свежей кровью.

trans-unit.source: A sword as perfect as its wielder strives to be. Forged in the eternal flame of Asuryan himself, this high elven style sword brings harmony to combat, allowing its master to fight with unmatched precision and endurance.
trans-unit.target: Меч, столь же совершенный, как и его владелец стремится быть. Выкованный в вечном пламени самого Асуриана, этот меч в стиле высших эльфов приносит гармонию в бой, позволяя хозяину сражаться с непревзойдённой точностью и выносливостью.

trans-unit.source: An armour by Kurnous design, light and barely noticeable. This dark green cloak carries the essence of the deep forest, concealing its wearer from enemy eyes while heightening awareness of one's surroundings.

trans-unit.source: A sword thirsting for blood as much as its master. With each strike, it hungers for more, growing stronger with each life it claims. The blade's edge never dulls when wetted with fresh blood.
trans-unit.target: 一把與主人一樣渴望鮮血的劍。每一次揮擊，它都渴望更多，隨著每一條生命的奪取而變得更強。當被新鮮血液浸濕時，劍刃永不變鈍。

trans-unit.source: A sword as perfect as its wielder strives to be. Forged in the eternal flame of Asuryan himself, this high elven style sword brings harmony to combat, allowing its master to fight with unmatched precision and endurance.
trans-unit.target: 一把如同其持有者所追求的那樣完美的劍。在阿蘇瑞安本人的永恆之火中鍛造，這把高等精靈風格的劍為戰鬥帶來和諧，使其主人能夠以無與倫比的精準和耐力戰鬥。

trans-unit.source: An armour by Kurnous design, light and barely noticeable. This dark green cloak carries the essence of the deep forest, concealing its wearer from enemy eyes while heightening awareness of one's surroundings.
trans-unit.target: 一件由庫爾諾斯設計的盔甲，輕盈且幾乎不引人注目。這件深綠色的斗篷承載著深林的精髓，能將佩戴者隱藏在敵人眼中，同時增強對周圍環境的感知。

trans-unit.source: This armor protects its wearer while he serves elven kind, prolonging his life to levels outside any expectation. The enchantments woven into each plate reject the corruption of undeath, allowing the wearer to walk both worlds.
trans-unit.target: 這套盔甲在佩戴者為精靈族服務時保護他們，將壽命延長到超出任何預期的水平。編織在每塊甲板中的附魔排斥亡靈的腐化，讓佩戴者能夠行走於兩個世界之間。
